From 1993Kl03. Some studies [e.g., (|a,2n|g) and 1982Ba28 in (n,|g)] propose that this |g is multiply placed, in particular that it may also deexcite the 1753.8, 6+ K=4 level. However, the relative I|g values of the 969.8 and 1169.0 |g's from the data of 1993Kl03 agree well with those from the {+156}Eu |b{+-} decay, where the 1169 peak is clearly a single |g. Further, the 1169 |g may have an E0 component, which is not expected for a placement from the 1753.8 level, for which |DK=4. The evaluator has concluded that the 1169 |g in (n,|g) is a single transition whose placement is from this 1258.0 level.
